name: Iori
message: 「Um, well then, let's begin class.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes!」
Asahi-chan was the only one who answered energetically. No one else was there.
Barely ten minutes since all the students of Takamura Class first met face-to-face in the classroom.
Takamura Class had completely fallen apart.

name: Iori
message: 「No, no, no, this obviously isn't going to work, right？！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Why not？」

name: Iori
message: 「I feel like there's no point holding class when not a single one of the original Takamura Class students is here...」

name: Asahi
message: 「That's cruel. I'm a member of Takamura Class starting today too, you know.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Being discriminated against by you makes me sad, Iori-san...」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, w-wait, don't cry？！」
Flustered at the sight of Asahi-chan's eyes welling up with tears.

name: Asahi
message: 「Sniff... In exchange for stopping my tears, I'd like some gentle headpats from you, Iori-san...」

name: Iori
message: 「A-Alright, fine.」
I gently patted Asahi-chan's head just as she asked.

name: Asahi
message: 「Hwaah...」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that enough？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Please keep going like this for about three hours.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, I'm only joking.」
Ah, Asahi-chan used to be so sweet, earnest, and adorable when she was a kid—how did she end up growing up like this...

name: Iori
message: 「Still, you're right, Asahi-chan.」

name: Iori
message: 「You're a member of Takamura Class starting today too, so I'll teach you properly just like everyone else. I promise.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Thank you very much, Iori-san.」

name: Iori
message: 「There's just one thing I want to ask of you.」

name: Iori
message: 「Starting today, I want you to call me 'Sensei' instead of 'Iori-san.' Otherwise, it won't set a good example for the others.」
Now that we're teacher and student, I can't let things get too lax. I have to draw a clear line between being friendly and getting overly familiar.

name: Asahi
message: 「Understood, Iori-sensei.」

name: Asahi
message: 「In that case, you'll have to stop calling me Asahi-chan as well, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, right. From now on, I'll call you Asahi-san.」

name: Asahi
message: 「No, Sensei. That would invite coddling.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Please drop the honorifics and call me just Asahi.」

name: Iori
message: 「G-Got it. If that's what Asahi-chan wants, I'll do it.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then please try calling me right away—just Asahi.」

name: Iori
message: 「A-Asahi.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I can hear hesitation. Please say it more naturally.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Very good. Let's repeat it.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, Asahi, Asahi!」

name: Asahi
message: 「More... Iori-sensei, rougher, please!」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, hey, Asahi！」

name: Asahi
message: 「No good, there's still softness left in it.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Do it mercilessly—like a drunk husband coming home from pachinko, kicking his wife and ripping away the meager money she earned from side work!」

name: Iori
message: 「Oi, Asahi, hand over the cash！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Aaah, good, that's so good...」

name: Iori
message: 「This is definitely the wrong kind of thing, isn't it？！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Heeheehee, I was so happy I ended up getting carried away.」

name: Iori
message: 「What on earth made you that happy...」
Asahi egged me on and dragged me into some bizarre little skit.

name: Asahi
message: 「Anyway, I look forward to your guidance starting today, Iori-sensei!」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, leave it to me.」
